name: desktop-readonly-field-treatment
goal: Make every read-only game view field visibly immutable while retaining navigation

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Visual review 4 rejects the readonly catalog state at all three viewports: only Dimension looks disabled; title and art direction look editable despite readonly attributes.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing standardized cases checked the readonly attribute and dimension picker but not the text fields painted treatment or focusability. Strengthen those same three post-capture cases to require disabled, muted fields and a visible read-only label.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Test checkpoint f7e7abdde8 fails the same readonly case at desktop, tablet and mobile: title remains enabled. Record770c5016019f3e2e5b88ad36222c9ee1d43ac886d6585300c9c7525c51accad6 retains all three original images.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Product-only fix0a3f92dbe4 disables title and art direction with the existing muted-control token, removes the resize affordance, and labels read-only settings. View navigation remains enabled.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Pinned matched pair: redffbb9d991f4cf695f3fda876877676591e2062f8c8093050c3c9cef483daed33 atf7e7abdde8 fails3; green456248ea3c189b2b3ce907bce5f610f09d176eb6514aff08e85c400a20869a45 at0a3f92dbe4 passes3. Same frozen tests, fixtures, command and profile; all six originals inspected.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
